marc: FYI - noticed intermittent 2-3x p99 spikes on mixtral-moerouter under a skewed expert workload. Captured a short CPU profile and a couple kernel traces. Posting findings here, want quick ops/triage ideas.

marc: pprof summary (20s sample window):
```
router_logit_compute 45%
softmax_generic 22%
kv_cache_lock 12%
cuda_kernel_dispatch 18%
memcpy 3%
```

anya: which runtime/build and the exact serving knobs? batch sizes, expert_parallelism, top_k, router temp?

marc: config snippet we ran (prod-like):
```yaml
model: mixtral-moex-16b
expert_parallelism: 2
router_top_k: 4
router_temperature: 1.2
max_batch_tokens: 1024
softmax_kernel: auto
kv_cache_mode: LRU
kv_prefetch: true
kv_max_entries: 1000000
batch_window_ms: 3
```

dev-bot: Note: runtime v1.13.0 had a softmax kernel selector change that can fallback to the generic path when head_dim % 64 != 0. See changelog: https://internal.redwood/rt/changelog#v1.13.0 (regression noted ENG-RT-9410).

saurabh: Two quick levers to try: lower router_temperature to ~0.9 and drop router_top_k to 2. That reduces expert saturation by making routing sharper -> fewer experts hot. Also try per-expert request queueing and enable `throttle_expert_on_queue_len` (small integer).

nina: I ran a small A/B on a lab cluster: baseline (temp=1.2/top_k=4/softmax=auto) p99=320ms. Experiment (temp=0.85/top_k=3/prefer_avx_softmax=true) p99=210ms, throughput +12%, no correctness regression on our eval set. Quick measurement log: `2026-02-27T14:02:12 p99=210ms q95=56ms rps=124`.

marc: Good signal. One more thing: the profile shows KV cache lock contention around eviction path. Stack excerpts show `kv_map::erase` holding a mutex while background eviction is synchronously doing `memcpy` for compaction. That lines up with occasional stalls in the request path when eviction triggers during heavy loads.

anya: For KV: try `kv_eviction_batch=16` and move eviction to dedicated bg thread (`kv_evict_background: true`). That reduces lock hold times since we batch erases and async memcpy. For batching heuristics, consider increasing `batch_window_ms` from 3 -> 6 to allow more coalescing at the router, but watch tail latency for short prompt workloads.

dev-bot: Created ticket ENG-RT-9421: "mixtral moerouter p99 spikes - softmax kernel fallback + kv eviction contention". Assigned: eng-runtime. Priority P2.

marc: Plan: 1) force optimized softmax kernel on canary (prefer_avx_softmax=true / kernel_force=avx512 when available), 2) lower router temp/top_k in control plane to reduce expert hotspots, 3) background batched KV eviction, 4) run 24h perf run with perf markers and detailed pprof. I'll post results next Tues. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
